focus.title: 美国拟扩大对华半导体设备出口管制，涵盖深紫外光刻机维护服务
focus.summary: 据多家外媒报道，拜登政府计划于2026年8月前发布新规，将深紫外（DUV）光刻机的维护、修理及备件供应纳入对华出口管制范围，旨在进一步限制中国成熟制程芯片产能扩张。此举将影响ASML、尼康等设备供应商对华服务协议，预计涉及约12亿美元存量设备维护市场。中芯国际、华虹半导体等企业需评估现有服务合同连续性，并加速国产替代备件验证。
focus.title_en: U.S. to Expand Chip Equipment Export Restrictions to Include DUV Lithography Maintenance Services
focus.summary_en: According to multiple foreign media reports, the Biden administration plans to issue new rules by August 2026, extending export controls to cover maintenance, repair, and spare parts supply for deep ultraviolet (DUV) lithography equipment in China, aiming to further restrict China's mature node chip capacity expansion. This will impact service agreements of suppliers like ASML and Nikon with China, involving an estimated $1.2 billion in maintenance services for installed equipment. Companies such as SMIC and Hua Hong Semiconductor need to assess continuity of existing service contracts and accelerate validation of domestic spare part alternatives.

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁庭认定：跨境数据存储协议中“合理安全措施”标准应参照国际公认加密准则
case.summary: 在SIAC仲裁案2025-089号中，仲裁庭就一家中国跨境电商企业与新加坡云服务商之间的数据泄露责任纠纷作出裁决。仲裁庭认为，合同约定的“合理安全措施”应按国际标准化组织（ISO）27001及通用数据保护条例（GDPR）技术标准解释，而非仅依据服务商所在国国内法。因服务商未采用AES-256加密且未定期进行渗透测试，构成违约。该案提示中国企业：在签订境外数据服务合同时，应明确定义安全标准并约定独立的第三方审计权。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC） · 2026年6月裁决
case.title_en: SIAC Tribunal Rules 'Reasonable Security Measures' in Cross-Border Data Storage Contracts Must Follow International Encryption Standards
case.summary_en: In SIAC arbitration case No. 2025-089, the tribunal ruled on a data breach liability dispute between a Chinese cross-border e-commerce company and a Singapore cloud service provider. The tribunal held that the contractual term 'reasonable security measures' should be interpreted by reference to ISO 27001 and GDPR technical standards, not merely the service provider's domestic law. The provider's failure to use AES-256 encryption and conduct regular penetration testing constituted a breach. This case reminds Chinese enterprises to clearly define security standards and stipulate independent third-party audit rights when signing overseas data service contracts.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC) · June 2026 Award

policy.title: 深圳前海发布《跨境数据流动合规指引》，明确金融、医疗等领域数据出境安全评估豁免情形
policy.summary: 深圳市前海深港现代服务业合作区管理局于7月28日发布《跨境数据流动合规指引（试行）》，对在区内注册的企业开展跨境数据流动提供操作细则。指引明确：在取得数据主体单独同意且完成个人信息保护影响评估（PIA）的前提下，涉及跨境支付、跨境保险理赔、临床试验数据共享等场景可申请豁免安全评估。同时要求企业建立数据出境台账并每半年向监管部门报送。该指引自2026年9月1日起实施，为粤港澳大湾区数据跨境提供先行先试经验。
policy.source: 来源：深圳市前海管理局 · 2026.07.28
policy.title_en: Qianhai Releases Cross-Border Data Flow Compliance Guidelines, Exempting Certain Financial and Medical Data Transfers from Security Assessment
policy.summary_en: The Qianhai Shenzhen-Hong Kong Modern Service Industry Cooperation Zone Authority issued the 'Cross-Border Data Flow Compliance Guidelines (Trial)' on July 28, providing operational rules for enterprises registered in the zone. The guidelines clarify that, subject to obtaining separate data subject consent and completing a Personal Information Protection Impact Assessment (PIA), scenarios such as cross-border payments, cross-border insurance claims, and clinical trial data sharing may apply for exemption from security assessment. Enterprises are required to maintain a data transfer ledger and report to regulators every six months. The guidelines take effect on September 1, 2026, offering a pilot experience for cross-border data flows in the Greater Bay Area.

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对华投资审查规则将扩至生物技术和人工智能，出海企业应提前搭建合规架构
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国财政部拟于2026年第四季度将生物技术（基因测序、合成生物学）和人工智能（大模型训练、自动驾驶算法）纳入对华投资审查范围。建议中国出海企业：（1）在引入美元基金或与美国关联实体合作前，进行反向CFIUS审查评估；（2）搭建VIE或合资架构时，确保核心技术资产由境内实体持有，并设置“防火墙”条款限制美方投资者获取敏感技术数据；（3）关注《2026年对外投资透明法案》草案动向，该法案可能要求披露中国投资方信息。Attorney Qin's view: As the U.S. Treasury plans to expand outbound investment review to biotech (gene sequencing, synthetic biology) and AI (large model training, autonomous driving algorithms) by Q4 2026, Chinese overseas-bound companies should (1) conduct reverse CFIUS assessments before introducing USD funds or partnering with U.S.-affiliated entities; (2) ensure core technology assets are held by onshore entities when setting up VIE or JV structures, with firewall clauses limiting U.S. investors' access to sensitive tech data; (3) monitor the draft 'Outbound Investment Transparency Act of 2026', which may require disclosure of Chinese investor information.
analysis.source: 来源：秦林蒿律师 · 律连全球 · 2026.07.29
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's View: U.S. Outbound Investment Review Expansion to Biotech and AI Calls for Preemptive Compliance Structuring
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: As the U.S. Treasury plans to expand outbound investment review to biotech (gene sequencing, synthetic biology) and AI (large model training, autonomous driving algorithms) by Q4 2026, Chinese overseas-bound companies should (1) conduct reverse CFIUS assessments before introducing USD funds or partnering with U.S.-affiliated entities; (2) ensure core technology assets are held by onshore entities when setting up VIE or JV structures, with firewall clauses limiting U.S. investors' access to sensitive tech data; (3) monitor the draft 'Outbound Investment Transparency Act of 2026', which may require disclosure of Chinese investor information.
analysis.source_en: Source: Attorney Qin Linhao · iGlobal Law · 2026.07.29
